title: PatchPad Editor - Harbor Task QC
subtitle: Fresh first-level QC after rubric compression and undo fixes.
note: Scope: static package/prompt/rubric/golden checks only. No Oracle/model RewardKit run artifacts were present under patchpad-editor.

tasks.name: PatchPad Editor
tasks.headline: Static QC is clean after fixes; the remaining blocker is run validation.

findings.what: No Harbor run artifacts were found under the task folder. run_inventory.py reported: "No trials found under patchpad-editor."
findings.why: The QC skill treats Oracle score 1.0 as the proof that the task is solvable. Static checks cannot establish that RewardKit, Playwright MCP, and the golden pass all 20 criteria end to end.
findings.impact: The task should not be considered delivery-ready until Oracle scores 1.0 and representative model runs show the intended score spread.
findings.fix: Run Oracle and at least the planned model set, then re-run QC in run-validation mode with result.json, reward.json, report.json, and agentic.json artifacts.
findings.evidence: CONFIRMED: bundled run_inventory.py found no trials at depths 1-3.

blocks.title: Fixed before this pass
items: Compressed browser rubric from 32 criteria to 20 criteria.
Reweighted simple merged criteria to 0.5, hard undo/multi-caret criteria to 2.0, and revision restore to 1.5.
Fixed contiguous typing undo grouping so one Undo reverses a typed word.
Fixed selection replacement typing and multi-caret typed insertion to use the same grouped undo behavior.
Confirmed revision restore is implemented as an unsaved dirty draft with a single pre-restore undo snapshot.
Removed brittle apt/Node package pins from the Dockerfile to avoid Daytona sandbox build failures.

blocks.title: Found clean after fixes
items: Required Harbor files are present: instruction.md, task.toml, environment/Dockerfile, solution/solve.sh, tests/test.sh.
task.toml and browser.toml parse successfully with Python tomllib.
Rubric has 20 criteria, all weighted between 0.5 and 2.0, with no zero-weight criteria; total raw weight is 15.5.
tests/test.py writes an initial 0.0 reward floor and catches BaseException; tests/test.sh also writes fallback reward files if Python exits before writing them.
Verifier prompt explicitly tells the judge not to trust APP_MANIFEST.md as grading evidence.
Server-side conflict and tampering checks exist via direct in-page fetch probes, not only UI button checks.
Node-based JavaScript syntax re-check could not be repeated in this shell because node is not currently available on PATH.
Upload zip has executable solve.sh/test.sh and contains no node_modules, DB files, logs, caches, or pyc files.

blocks.title: Checks not run
items: Full Oracle RewardKit browser run was not executed in this first-level pass.
No model run spread was available, so the target of Oracle 1.0 and model score below 0.7 is unproven.
